summary: Zenta Group Company Limited, a Macau-based consulting firm listed in the US under a Form 6-K equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, disclosed completion of its acquisition of 100% of the equity interests of ZentoAI Intelligent Technology Company Limited from the Target's selling shareholders. The share purchase agreement was signed September 9, 2026, and the deal closed September 11, 2026. No price, premium, or advisor terms were stated. The filing supplies audited Target financials for fiscal 2025 and 2024, interim statements through March 31, 2026, and pro forma combined figures, signaling the Target is a significant business under Regulation S-X Rule 3-05. Watch integration execution and any subsequent purchase-price or consideration disclosure.
